header:
# Town of Starksboro municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Keegan Tierney was elected Moderator with 328 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Koran Cousino (Chair), Eric Cota, Carin Mccarthy, Tony Porter, and David Schmidt

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Koran Cousino was re-elected with 249 votes, Carin H. McCarthy with 298, and Tony Porter to a remainder seat with 310
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Starksboro official website, town clerk page: Amy McCormick is the Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Amy McCormick as Starksboro's Town Clerk

Town of Starksboro official website: the clerk's page staff block shows Alexandra ('Ali') Thompson serving as Treasurer. The town's elected-officials list and its March 2026 ballot both omit a treasurer contest although 17 V.S.A. sec. 2646 makes the office elective, so she is seated APPOINTED on the town's own presentation (flagged on issue #163)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Alexandra Thompson as Starksboro's Town Treasurer

offices.org_name: Town of Starksboro Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes
Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Amy McCormick was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 330 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Charles Webber was elected Lister with 297 votes; the other two seats' current holders are published nowhere official
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): both 2026 auditor contests were write-in only and no winner is named in the official results, so the post is created without memberships (straggler)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable
Town of Starksboro, 2022-2023 Town Report, elected-officials list (officers with board sizes): the First Constable is printed 'Vacant'

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): the 2026 constable contest was write-in only with no winner named, so the seat stands unfilled
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a second constable

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): the 2026 constable contests were write-in only with no winner named, so the seat stands unfilled

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Norman Cota was elected Cemetery Commissioner with 326 votes; the other two seats' current holders are published nowhere official

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Emily Fisher was elected Library Trustee with 293 votes, Leah Hamilton with 284, and Ellen Yount to a remainder seat with 308

Town of Starksboro, Warning for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026: Article elects Planning Commissioners by ballot, so the commission is an ELECTED body under 24 V.S.A. sec. 4323, which permits a town to elect its planning commission

Town of Starksboro, 2022-2023 Town Report, elected-officials list (officers with board sizes): the elected list prints seven Planning Commission roster lines (four members serving and three seats resigned), fixing the commission at seven seats (disclosed in the sources)

Town of Starksboro, official results ballot for the annual meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, starksborovt.org): Dan Nugent was elected Planning Commissioner with 287 votes; the other current members are published nowhere official
